title: Park or Page Inspection decision for U-VEND Manual Nos
purpose: Avoid another blind U-VEND Manual Nos checkbox attempt after D2G proved source basis but no unique row-scoped checkbox candidate.

smartDecision.whyNow: D2F and D2G both reached Page 456 for U-VEND but did not prove a safe row-scoped Manual Nos write route.

sourceBasis.title: Microsoft Learn: Integrate with Dynamics 365 Field Service

smartDecision.decisionNeeded: Either Page Inspection exposes a safe field/value route for U-VEND Manual Nos, or vendor manual-numbering is parked and the next Foundation step moves away from this blocker.
smartDecision.risk: A non-row-scoped checkbox click can change the wrong number series or false-positive a setup proof.
smartDecision.fallback: Park manual vendor numbering and choose a non-vendor Foundation dependency with explicit rationale.

acceptanceCriteria: No setup, master data, document, Preview Posting, Posting or API shortcut occurs.
D2F/D2G list/cell/DOM routes are not repeated as write attempts.
A clear decision is written: safe Page Inspection route, park U-VEND Manual Nos, or helper-fix requirement.
The next case is selected from lookahead and does not create a vendor while U-VEND Manual Nos remains unproven.
stopIf: Business Central does not show playthru / UNIVERSAARL-DE.
A dialog asks to save, confirm setup, delete, preview, post, create or switch company.
The only available route is another unscoped checkbox/cell click.

nextStepDecision.lastEvidenceSummary: D2G proved source basis for Manual Nos but blocked because no unique U-VEND Manual Nos checkbox candidate was exposed read-only.
nextStepDecision.reason: This case prevents another blind write attempt and forces either technical field proof or an explicit park decision.

lookaheadReviewed.reason: Vendor creation remains blocked until U-VEND Manual Nos is active after reopen.
Useful fallback if U-VEND manual-numbering is parked.
VAT matrix remains separate and must not be mixed into number-series recovery.

nextStepDecision.whySelectedNextCaseIsBest: It resolves whether U-VEND manual numbering should continue or be parked before any vendor retry.
risksBeforeNextCase: Unnecessary time spent on repeated BC grid routes
